consumer: law_set dataset governance chain (gate + publication chain + bundle export + distribution consumers)
title: Evorule Law entry (law_set dataset payload, v1.1 intake discipline)
description: Law entry payload contract for law_set datasets, v1.1. Opt-in bump over frozen v1.0: two required intake-discipline fields added. form: four-form axis (equation_identity | constraint | procedure | definition) so gates pick criteria by form. intake_channel: immutable origin fact (human_curated | llm_proposal), orthogonal to per-entry trust level - origin is never laundered by trust promotion. All other fields identical to v1.0 (nine semantic elements + max_version_depth/monotone_form required, time_anchor for negation-construct rewrites). SSOT for this domain schema family: evorule-system-rules schemas/law_set/v1.1.json ($defs/law); this file is the rule-repo domain-namespace edition consumed by the D3 resolver. Publication chain emits v1.1 documents.

domains.description: Multi-domain ownership vector (default absent = single-domain semantics via domain)

cross_refs.description: Explicit cross-domain reference edges (D2=A: declared at registration, auto-discovery forbidden)

max_version_depth.description: Version-chain height h_p (finiteness declaration): required, integer >= 1

monotone_form.description: Monotone-form declaration: must be true (non-monotone laws are rejected; resubmit as a time-anchored rewrite)

time_anchor.description: Time-anchored rewrite declaration anchor (optional; required non-empty when the formula hits a negation construct)

form.description: Four-form axis (required at intake): gates pick criteria by form

intake_channel.description: Origin channel (immutable audit fact): orthogonal to trust level - origin is never laundered by trust promotion
